# use-bioinformatics

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse bioinformatics facade.

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-bioinformatics/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-bioinformatics/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-bioinformatics/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
